title: Left row after an action
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine over an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $\alpha$ be an action, and let $a\in\mathbb{Z}$. Assume that every work-tape head in $c$ is at a coordinate at least $a$, and that every work tape is blank at coordinate $a-1$. The block at coordinate $a-1$ after applying $\alpha$ to $c$, with preceding-block flags cleared, has no symbols and marks tape $i$ exactly when its head in $c$ is at $a$ and $\alpha$ moves that tape's head left.
